Arcane

ar-KAYN · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Arcane is understood by only a select few; mysterious.

The tax form referenced an arcane subsection that even the accountant had to look up.

Worked Example

Only a handful of longtime members still understood the club's arcane bylaws about who could nominate a new officer.

Arcane fits knowledge or rules kept within a small, specialized group -- not necessarily complicated, just rarely shared outside it.

How Arcane Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

recondite

recondite: difficult to understand and known to very few

mystifying

mystifying: puzzling and hard to make sense of

Antonyms

common

common: known to or shared by everyone

mainstream

mainstream: regarded as normal, ordinary, and widely accepted

How Strong Is It? — specialized → arcane → occult

specialized vs. arcane

specialized vs. arcane: Specialized vocabulary in a hobby forum might take newcomers a week or two to pick up.

occult vs. arcane

occult vs. arcane: Occult knowledge, in its original sense, means intentionally hidden from all but a select initiated few.

Build the Word

The pieces

Put it together

Put it together: Arcane comes from Latin arcanus, "secret," itself related to arca, "a locked chest" -- something arcane is knowledge kept locked away from most people.
